notes.title: New home page hero
items: New home page hero: the four things Townhall Records manages (Voter List, Attendance, Meeting and Election Management), works offline and online and with and without paper, three promises (every step dated and time stamped, over 40 options, no subscription), the old 'madness' line removed.

notes.title: Home page rewritten
items: The home page content was rewritten from the association's point of view.
The small mark was added to the home, privacy and terms pages.

notes.title: Small mark
items: The small mark १३९ at the very top centre of every page.

notes.title: Screens arrive
items: First screens for the public page, the team desk and the voter page.
Plain-words error messages that say how to fix each problem.

notes.title: Engine and rules
items: Signed, tamper-evident record of every action.
Online and printed ballots, 4-digit check-in, privacy requests.
